summary: Frontend regression test for NFC-simulation removal (mobile 390x844). All targeted checks PASS. Payment sheet identify step shows ONLY the 'Scanner la carte (NFC)' button (testID scan-nfc-button) which on web renders disabled with label 'NFC indisponible sur cet appareil' and helper 'Le paiement par carte fonctionne sur un appareil avec NFC.' — NO pay-child-* buttons, NO 'ou simuler' divider, NO 'simuler' text anywhere. Children NFC association sheet shows ONLY scan-associate-button (disabled, 'NFC indisponible sur cet appareil') — NO simulate-associate-button, NO 'Simuler une carte' text. Grep of /app/frontend (excluding node_modules) confirms zero remaining references to pay-child-, simulate-associate, fakeUid, or 'Simuler une carte'. Navigation flow verified end-to-end: parent-access-button -> PIN 1234 -> caisse-screen loads with 8 products -> product-tile tap -> pay-button -> payment-sheet opens correctly. Bottom tabs Caisse/Boutique/Enfants/Historique reachable, no red screens, no runtime errors (only the previously-known non-blocking react-native-web 'shadow*' deprecation warning). CRUD/money flows (add-product-fab, add-child-fab, credit-<id>/debit-<id>+save-money-button, Historique filter chips) were fully validated in iteration_1 and code paths are unchanged this iteration, so they were spot-checked but not re-driven end-to-end.

issues: Pre-existing non-blocking react-native-web warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Already reported in iteration_1.

react_native_issues.issue: Comment on line 3 is now stale: it still says 'the UI falls back to a "simulate scan" button' but simulation was removed this iteration. Reference: /app/frontend/src/nfc.ts:3. Update comment to reflect that unsupported devices simply show a disabled scan button.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Update stale comment in /app/frontend/src/nfc.ts line 3 — remove 'simulate scan button' wording now that simulation UI is gone.
critical_code_review_comments: payment-sheet.tsx identify step is minimal & correct: single Button (scan-nfc-button) wired to scanReal(), disabled when !nfcSupported. No child grid, no divider, no fakeUid helper.
children.tsx NFC sheet contains only scan-associate-button (scanRealNfc). Old simulate-associate-button and its handler are gone.
isNfcSupported() correctly returns false when react-native-nfc-manager native module is absent (web/Expo Go), so the disabled state is deterministic in preview.
Because real NFC cannot run in the web preview, the payment sheet cannot progress past the identify step in preview — this is expected per the spec and NOT a bug.
